item.title: Video: Ablakwa addresses transatlantic slave trade at UN - MyJoyOnline
UN resolution on slavery aims to confront slave trade’s enduring injustice - Okudzeto Ablakwa - MyJoyOnline
item.description: Ghana’s Minister for Foreign Affairs, Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, has stated that the ongoing United Nations high-level meeting on the resolution on slavery is among efforts designed to confront the legacy of the transatlantic slave trade, which he described as an enduring injustice with far-reaching consequences.

item.title: We need to reclaim dignity and humanity of Africans - Mahama - MyJoyOnline
item.description: President John Dramani Mahama is calling for a fundamental shift in how the history of slavery is understood, urging the global community to recognise it as a crime against humanity while restoring the dignity of those affected.

item.title: Atrocities against enslaved Africans happened because they were seen as objects - Mahama - MyJoyOnline
item.description: President John Mahama has said the brutalities and enduring injustices of slavery were made possible because enslaved Africans were deliberately reduced to objects rather than recognised as human beings.

item.title: Truth at risk: Journalism in the age of artificial intelligence - MyJoyOnline
item.description: As AI reshapes how information is created and consumed, the future of credible journalism hangs in the balance.

item.title: Fellow Ghanaians: The hospitals we have to be ashamed of - MyJoyOnline
item.description: Fellow Ghanaians, there is a particular kind of cruelty in being sick. item.title: International relations expert calls for justice and apology for centuries of African suffering - MyJoyOnline
item.description: International relations expert Nana Yaw Mireku has backed calls for the global community to formally recognise the transatlantic slave trade as a grave crime against humanity, emphasising the need for justice, accountability, and a formal apology for centuries of African suffering.

item.title: President Mahama urges leaders to ‘speak truth to power’ ahead of UN slavery resolution vote - MyJoyOnline
item.description: President John Dramani Mahama has called on Member States of the United Nations (UN) to “speak truth to power” and support the passage of a historic UN resolution addressing the legacy of slavery.

item.title: Eating the giants: The climate cost of Techiman’s vanishing “bungalow mountains” - MyJoyOnline
item.description: Before the big machines came. Before the dust filled the rivers. There was a mountain. The people of Techiman called it “Bungalow” because from far away it looked like the roof of a house—green, strong, and giving shade.

item.title: Agric Minister fires back at FABAG over tomato crisis - MyJoyOnline
item.description: The Minister for Food and Agriculture, Eric Opoku, has responded to the ultimatum issued by the Food and Beverages Association of Ghana (FABAG), defending the ministry’s efforts to address the ongoing tomato supply crisis.
